Effective hair loss treatments depend on identifying the underlying cause—such as hereditary pattern baldness, stress, or medical conditions—with options ranging from `daily medications to surgical procedures`.[[1]](https://www.mayoclinic.org/diseases-conditions/hair-loss/diagnosis-treatment/drc-20372932)[[2]](https://www.goodrx.com/conditions/hair-loss/hair-loss-treatment)[[3]](https://www.aad.org/public/diseases/hair-loss/treatment/diagnosis-treat)

### FDA-Approved Medications

- **Minoxidil (Rogaine):** Available over-the-counter as a liquid, foam, or shampoo for men and women. It stimulates hair growth and slows thinning, requiring consistent daily application for at least 6 months to see results.[[1]](https://www.health.harvard.edu/skin-and-hair-health/treating-hair-loss-in-men-what-works)[[2]](https://www.mayoclinic.org/diseases-conditions/hair-loss/diagnosis-treatment/drc-20372932)
- **Finasteride (Propecia):** A prescription-only oral pill for men that blocks the hormone DHT to slow hair loss and promote regrowth.[[1]](https://www.vcuhealth.org/news/a-dermatologists-guide-to-hair-loss-treatments/)[[2]](https://www.mayoclinic.org/diseases-conditions/hair-loss/diagnosis-treatment/drc-20372932)[[3]](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/services/hair-loss-treatment)
- **Other Oral & Topical Options:** Doctors may also prescribe oral minoxidil, dutasteride, or spironolactone (for women) depending on individual needs.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JwL1yS5Su5U&t=8)[[2]](https://www.mayoclinic.org/diseases-conditions/hair-loss/diagnosis-treatment/drc-20372932)

### Procedures and In-Office Therapies

- **Hair Transplant Surgery:** Dermatologists or cosmetic surgeons move hair follicles from a denser donor area (usually the back or sides of the head) to thinning or balding spots.
- **Platelet-Rich Plasma (PRP):** Injections of concentrated platelets from your own blood are used to stimulate weak hair follicles.
- **Low-Level Laser Therapy:** FDA-cleared light devices or laser caps can help improve hair density for hereditary hair loss.[[1]](https://www.goodrx.com/conditions/hair-loss/hair-loss-treatment)[[2]](https://www.mayoclinic.org/diseases-conditions/hair-loss/diagnosis-treatment/drc-20372932)[[3]](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/services/hair-loss-treatment)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tkF54Oc-uxo)

### Cosmetic and Lifestyle Approaches

- **Hairpieces and Styling:** Wigs, extensions, volumizing shampoos, and smart hair cuts help camouflage temporary or permanent thinning.
- **Nutritional Support:** Vitamins and supplements only promote hair growth if you have a confirmed dietary deficiency.[[1]](https://www.mayoclinic.org/diseases-conditions/hair-loss/diagnosis-treatment/drc-20372932)[[2]](https://www.vcuhealth.org/news/a-dermatologists-guide-to-hair-loss-treatments/)

To help narrow down what might work best, tell me:

- Are you noticing hair loss **gradually (pattern thinning)** or **suddenly (in clumps/patches)**?
- Are you looking for options for a **man or a woman**?
